facets.description: Blacklist check (handler line 77) compares the raw guest email against the lowercased BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS list, so a mixed-case email gets past the blacklist
Existing-attendee check (handler line 76, guest === attendee.email) is case-sensitive, so a case variant of an existing attendee is inserted again

No server-side dedupe of the submitted guests array: the schema has no uniqueness refine and the handler filter doesn't dedupe, so createMany inserts duplicate attendee rows and sends duplicate emails

The attendee read (line 26) and write (line 92) happen without a transaction, so concurrent calls both pass the check and insert duplicates or throw an unhandled Prisma unique-constraint (P2002) error
